name: Hermano da Silva Ramos
bio: Brazilian father, French mother, born and raised in Paris, and racing for Equipe Gordini by 1955 — the year he took an Aston Martin DB2/4 to sixteenth in the Mille Miglia. Seven Grands Prix across 1955 and 1956 brought two points. He outlived very nearly everyone: from 2023 until his death in 2026, at a hundred, he was the oldest living man to have started a Formula One Grand Prix.
